Kitroom: screen map

Target power-apps, canvas 1366 × 768. Design: DESIGN.md (Kitroom). Start at the first screen. Every screen opens from disk with JavaScript off.

  1. Loans scrLoanList

    Start screen: every current loan, filterable by status, with a way to open one or start a new one.

  2. New loan scrNewLoan

    Request an item: what, how many, when it comes back, where to collect it, and why.

  3. Loan detail scrLoanDetail

    One loan in full, with the actions its borrower can take.

Lists this mockup implies: Loans. Flows it implies: NotifyApprover, ReportLostItem.
